mission: Make DreamCo repositories predictable enough that nontechnical users and coding agents can update them the same way starting from the original Dreamcobots repository.
simple_user_rule: Users describe what they want; agents find the files and tests.

required_paths..github/workflows: buttons, scheduled checks and deployment automation

update_flow: change is made in shared owner when reusable
Buddy Actions Test Lab or Control Center verifies the relevant system
Buddy Debugger handles failures using evidence
copy_rule: Forks/templates should preserve this structure and workflow/agent names so instructions remain the same across DreamCo-based repositories.
truth_rule: Standard structure makes maintenance easier but does not guarantee every copied repository is operational until its own dependencies, secrets, permissions, integrations and Actions runs pass.
